outcomes.title: Skills you can use the next working day
outcomes.subtitle: Every course is built around real work — you leave with something you can apply, not a certificate to file away.

planning.title: Plan and deliver work
planning.description: Turn scope into a plan, manage risk and stakeholders, and keep delivery on track from kickoff to launch.

flow.title: Manage the flow of work
flow.description: Visualise work, limit work in progress and keep delivery predictable with Kanban-style flow management.

analysis.description: Turn ambiguity into clear specs and decisions that hold up once work actually starts.

leadership.title: Lead people and product
leadership.description: Align stakeholders, teams and product decisions so what you build survives contact with production.

audience.subtitle: One practitioner's platform for the roles that turn plans into shipped work.

pm.title: Project managers
pm.description: Plan, sequence and deliver initiatives without losing sight of risk, budget and stakeholders.

product.title: Product managers

team.title: Product team members

approach.title: Self-paced, on one platform
approach.subtitle: No cohorts, no live calls to catch. You move at your own speed and your progress is always saved.

1.title: Work through chapters and lessons
1.description: Each course is split into chapters and lessons with text, images, video and audio — structured so you can go deep without getting lost.

2.title: Track progress as you go
2.description: The platform remembers where you stopped and what you've completed, so picking back up takes seconds.

3.title: Practise on real work
3.description: Every course is built around applying the ideas to work you actually do — not memorising for an exam.

author.title: One person, and someone who ships
author.subtitle: This is Sergey Sidorov's personal LMS — built solo, to teach the craft of project management in modern conditions.
author.name: Sergey Sidorov
author.role: Founder · project lead and product manager
author.bio: A professional in project management and IT product development. Much of his career was spent on flagship projects at Kaspersky Lab. He built this school himself, from the ground up, to pass on what actually works — planning, delivery, stakeholder and team leadership, and working with modern, AI-assisted tools. He removes uncertainty, drives initiatives to completion, and designs systems that survive production.

1.question: Who is this for?
1.answer: Project managers, product managers, systems analysts, and other product-team roles who want practical skills — not certificates for their own sake.

2.question: Do I need a project management background already?
2.answer: No single background is required — courses are practical and built for people already doing the work, whatever stage they're at. Check each course's description before enrolling.

3.question: How are courses delivered?
3.answer: Self-paced on the platform: chapters and lessons with text, images, video, and audio, with progress tracked as you go.

4.question: Can I suggest a topic?
4.answer: Yes. Email hello{'@'}s-sidorov.ru — we keep every request, and new courses can be shaped by what people actually ask for.

5.question: Who runs this school?
5.answer: One person so far — Sergey Sidorov. See the instructor section and s-sidorov.ru.

6.question: How do I enrol?
6.answer: Sign in with your PMI Club or Google account, open a course and start — there's no separate checkout.

7.question: Is this a company?
7.answer: No — it's Sergey Sidorov's personal project, not a company. Read more about him at s-sidorov.ru.
